question: What kind of knowledge yields true liberation without remainder?
premises: Some knowledge is still marked by limitations.
Knowledge of the true knowable reality can be free from all limitations.
Where no limitation remains, ignorance has no foothold.
inference: Therefore knowledge of the true knowable reality that is free from all limitations leaves no room for ignorance and gives true liberation.
uncertainties: sarvātmanojjhitam is terse; it is taken here as devoid of limitation in every respect.
plain_english: But knowledge of the true knowable reality that is free from every limitation leaves no place anywhere for ignorance, and that knowledge gives true liberation.
